limits: Writer refusal may leave a partial report in the destination; no downstream consumption or durable-storage acknowledgement is claimed.
Native /dev/full and closed-pipe tests cover actual buffered flush and unbuffered write errors, not every arbitrary Python text stream or stderr failure.
The prior depth-change full Mac suite result remains 227 passed, 1 skipped, 1 failed because its unchanged comparison receiver requires Linux /dev/full.
No browser, installed service, live state, planner, audit hash/lifecycle, dependency or workflow change.

Best-effort stream close is cleanup and can internally flush pending buffered bytes. No zero-low-level-write guarantee is made; the command does not regenerate or explicitly write a second report after refusal.
